<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Menú - Parrilla Fuego &amp; Brasas</title>
<link href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/bootstrap/5.3.3/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* =========================================================
     TOKENS
     ========================================================= */
  :root{
    --azul-950:#081524;
    --azul-900:#0c2038;
    --azul-800:#123252;
    --azul-700:#1a466c;
    --azul-line: rgba(245,241,230,0.14);
    --naranja-600:#d9541f;
    --naranja-500:#e8672c;
    --naranja-300:#f2a75c;
    --crema:#f5f1e6;
    --crema-muted:#a9bdd4;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }

  body {
    font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    background-color: var(--azul-950);
    color: var(--crema);
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  h1, h2, h3, .display {
    font-family: "Oswald", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }

  a { color: inherit; }

  /* ---------- BARRA SUPERIOR ---------- */
  .barra-superior {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 1030;
    background-color: rgba(8, 21, 36, 0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
  }
  .barra-superior .franja {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    max-width: 1180px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 14px 24px;
    gap: 20px;
  }
  .marca {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .marca .llama {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--naranja-300), var(--naranja-600));
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 18px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .marca .nombre {
    font-family: "Oswald", sans-serif;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: var(--crema);
    line-height: 1.1;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .marca .nombre small {
    display: block;
    font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: var(--naranja-300);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .nav-cortes {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    flex: 1;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .nav-cortes::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .nav-cortes a {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--crema-muted);
    font-size: 14px;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
  }
  .nav-cortes a:hover {
    background-color: var(--azul-800);
    color: var(--crema);
  }

  .btn-carrito {
    background-color: var(--naranja-500);
    color: var(--azul-950);
    border: none;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 14px;
    padding: 9px 18px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .btn-carrito:hover {
    background-color: var(--naranja-300);
    color: var(--azul-950);
  }

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 78vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    overflow: hidden;
    background-color: var(--azul-950);
  }
  .hero-imagen {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center 35%;
  }
  .hero-degradado {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8,21,36,0.35) 0%, rgba(8,21,36,0.55) 45%, rgba(8,21,36,0.97) 92%),
                linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(8,21,36,0.9) 0%, rgba(8,21,36,0.15) 55%);
  }
  .hero-contenido {
    position: relative;
    max-width: 1180px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 60px 24px 56px;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .hero-etiqueta {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    color: var(--naranja-300);
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .hero-etiqueta::before {
    content: "";
    width: 26px;
    height: 2px;
    background-color: var(--naranja-300);
  }
  .hero h1 {
    font-size: 64px;
    line-height: 0.98;
    margin: 0 0 20px;
    color: var(--crema);
    max-width: 780px;
  }
  .hero h1 em {
    font-style: normal;
    color: var(--naranja-500);
  }
  .hero p.bajada {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: var(--crema-muted);
    max-width: 480px;
    margin: 0 0 32px;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }
  .hero-acciones {
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .btn-hero-principal {
    background-color: var(--naranja-500);
    color: var(--azul-950);
    border: none;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 14px 30px;
    font-size: 15px;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }
  .btn-hero-principal:hover {
    background-color: var(--naranja-300);
    color: var(--azul-950);
  }
  .btn-hero-secundario {
    background-color: transparent;
    color: var(--crema);
    border: 1px solid rgba(245,241,230,0.4);
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 14px 30px;
    font-size: 15px;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }
  .btn-hero-secundario:hover {
    border-color: var(--crema);
    color: var(--crema);
    background-color: rgba(245,241,230,0.06);
  }

  /* ---------- DESTACADOS (scroll horizontal) ---------- */
  .franja-destacados {
    background-color: var(--azul-900);
    padding: 46px 0 50px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
  }
  .encabezado-seccion {
    max-width: 1180px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 26px;
  }
  .encabezado-seccion .titulo-grupo .ceja {
    color: var(--naranja-300);
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .encabezado-seccion h2 {
    font-size: 30px;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--crema);
  }
  .encabezado-seccion .nota {
    color: var(--crema-muted);
    font-size: 14px;
    max-width: 280px;
    text-align: right;
  }

  .rieles-destacados {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    padding: 4px 24px 10px;
    max-width: 1180px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
  }
  .tarjeta-destacado {
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    flex: 0 0 240px;
    background-color: var(--azul-800);
    border: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
    overflow: hidden;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--crema);
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .tarjeta-destacado img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 190px;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
    filter: saturate(1.05);
  }
  .tarjeta-destacado .info {
    padding: 14px 16px 18px;
    border-top: 3px solid var(--naranja-500);
  }
  .tarjeta-destacado .info h3 {
    font-size: 17px;
    margin: 0 0 4px;
    color: var(--crema);
  }
  .tarjeta-destacado .info .precio {
    color: var(--naranja-300);
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 15px;
  }

  /* ---------- NAVEGACIÓN RÁPIDA DE SECCIONES ---------- */
  .chips-secciones {
    position: sticky;
    top: 63px;
    z-index: 1020;
    background-color: var(--azul-950);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
    padding: 12px 24px;
  }
  .chips-secciones .fila {
    max-width: 1180px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }
  .chips-secciones .fila::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .chip {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--crema-muted);
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 7px 16px;
    border: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
    border-radius: 999px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .chip:hover {
    border-color: var(--naranja-500);
    color: var(--naranja-300);
  }

  /* ---------- CONTENEDOR GENERAL DE SECCIONES ---------- */
  .contenedor {
    max-width: 1180px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
  }
  .seccion {
    padding: 64px 0;
    scroll-margin-top: 130px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
  }
  .seccion:last-of-type { border-bottom: none; }

  /* ---------- CORTES: item destacado + rejilla ---------- */
  .rejilla-cortes {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
  }
  .item-corte {
    position: relative;
    background-color: var(--azul-900);
    border: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .item-corte.destacado {
    grid-column: span 4;
  }
  .item-corte.normal {
    grid-column: span 3;
  }
  .item-corte .marco-imagen {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .item-corte.destacado .marco-imagen { height: 340px; }
  .item-corte.normal .marco-imagen { height: 220px; }
  .item-corte img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
    transition: transform 0.4s ease;
  }
  .item-corte:hover img { transform: scale(1.045); }
  .item-corte .marco-imagen::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(8,21,36,0.92) 0%, rgba(8,21,36,0) 55%);
  }
  .etiqueta-corte {
    position: absolute;
    top: 14px;
    left: 14px;
    z-index: 2;
    background-color: var(--naranja-500);
    color: var(--azul-950);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 4px 10px;
  }
  .cuerpo-corte {
    padding: 18px 20px 22px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1;
  }
  .item-corte.destacado .cuerpo-corte h3 { font-size: 28px; }
  .cuerpo-corte h3 {
    color: var(--crema);
    font-size: 21px;
    margin: 0 0 8px;
  }
  .cuerpo-corte .descripcion {
    color: var(--crema-muted);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    margin: 0 0 16px;
    flex: 1;
  }
  .fila-precio-accion {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    padding-top: 14px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
  }
  .precio-corte {
    color: var(--naranja-300);
    font-family: "Oswald", sans-serif;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .btn-ver-detalle {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--crema);
    border: 1px solid rgba(245,241,230,0.35);
    font-size: 12px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 8px 16px;
  }
  .btn-ver-detalle:hover {
    background-color: var(--naranja-500);
    border-color: var(--naranja-500);
    color: var(--azul-950);
  }

  /* ---------- ENTRADAS Y BEBIDAS: filas tipo lista ---------- */
  .lista-items {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .fila-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 22px;
    padding: 22px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
  }
  .fila-item:first-child { padding-top: 0; }
  .fila-item .miniatura {
    width: 96px;
    height: 96px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
  }
  .fila-item .miniatura img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  .fila-item .texto {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .fila-item .texto h3 {
    color: var(--crema);
    font-size: 19px;
    margin: 0 0 4px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .etiqueta-mini {
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--naranja-300);
    border: 1px solid var(--naranja-600);
    padding: 2px 8px;
  }
  .fila-item .texto p {
    color: var(--crema-muted);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .fila-item .precio-accion {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-end;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .fila-item .precio-accion .precio-corte { font-size: 20px; }
  .fila-item .btn-ver-detalle { padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 11px; }

  /* ---------- POSTRES: rejilla 2 col ---------- */
  .rejilla-postres {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
  }
  .tarjeta-postre {
    background-color: var(--azul-900);
    border: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
    display: flex;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .tarjeta-postre .marco-imagen {
    width: 42%;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .tarjeta-postre img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
    min-height: 190px;
  }
  .tarjeta-postre .cuerpo-corte { padding: 20px; }

  /* ---------- MARIDAJE ---------- */
  .franja-maridaje {
    background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--azul-900) 0%, var(--azul-800) 100%);
    padding: 50px 0;
  }
  .tarjeta-maridaje {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1.4fr;
    gap: 40px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .tarjeta-maridaje h2 {
    color: var(--crema);
    font-size: 30px;
    margin: 0 0 12px;
  }
  .tarjeta-maridaje > div:first-child p {
    color: var(--crema-muted);
    font-size: 14.5px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    max-width: 380px;
    margin: 0;
  }
  .lista-maridaje {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
  }
  .par-maridaje {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 14px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  .par-maridaje:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .par-maridaje .plato { color: var(--crema); font-weight: 500; }
  .par-maridaje .flecha { color: var(--naranja-500); padding: 0 14px; }
  .par-maridaje .bebida { color: var(--crema-muted); }

  /* ---------- PIE ---------- */
  .pie {
    background-color: var(--azul-950);
    border-top: 3px solid var(--naranja-500);
    padding: 50px 0 30px;
  }
  .pie .rejilla-pie {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 30px;
    margin-bottom: 34px;
  }
  .pie h4 {
    font-family: "Oswald", sans-serif;
    color: var(--crema);
    font-size: 15px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin: 0 0 14px;
  }
  .pie .marca .nombre { font-size: 22px; }
  .pie .col p, .pie .col li {
    color: var(--crema-muted);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    line-height: 1.9;
  }
  .pie .col ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
  .pie .col a.reserva {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-top: 10px;
    color: var(--naranja-300);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 13.5px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--naranja-600);
    padding-bottom: 2px;
  }
  .franja-inferior {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
    padding-top: 20px;
    color: var(--crema-muted);
    font-size: 12px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* ---------- MODALES ---------- */
  .modal-content {
    background-color: var(--azul-900);
    border-radius: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
  }
  .modal-header {
    background-color: var(--naranja-500);
    color: var(--azul-950);
    border-bottom: none;
  }
  .modal-header .modal-title {
    font-family: "Oswald", sans-serif;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }
  .modal-header .btn-close {
    filter: none;
  }
  .modal-body {
    color: var(--crema);
  }
  .modal-body img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 260px;
    object-fit: cover;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
  }
  .modal-body p { color: var(--crema-muted); }
  .modal-precio {
    color: var(--naranja-300);
    font-family: "Oswald", sans-serif;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 24px;
  }
  .modal-cantidad {
    width: 70px;
    background-color: var(--azul-800);
    color: var(--crema);
    border: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
  }
  .modal-footer {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--azul-line);
  }
  .btn-agregar {
    background-color: var(--naranja-500);
    color: var(--azul-950);
    font-weight: 600;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }
  .btn-agregar:hover {
    background-color: var(--naranja-300);
    color: var(--azul-950);
  }
  .btn-secondary {
    background-color: transparent;
    border: 1px solid rgba(245,241,230,0.35);
    color: var(--crema);
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  .toast-container { z-index: 1080; }
  #toastCarrito.bg-success {
    background-color: var(--naranja-500) !important;
    color: var(--azul-950) !important;
  }

  /* =========================================================
     RESPONSIVO
     ========================================================= */
  @media screen and (max-width: 991px) {
    .hero h1 { font-size: 46px; }
    .rejilla-cortes { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .item-corte.destacado, .item-corte.normal { grid-column: span 2; }
    .item-corte.destacado .marco-imagen { height: 260px; }
    .tarjeta-maridaje { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
    .pie .rejilla-pie { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
    .barra-superior .franja { padding: 12px 16px; gap: 10px; }
    .marca .nombre { font-size: 16px; }
    .nav-cortes { display: none; }
    .hero { min-height: 64vh; }
    .hero-contenido { padding: 40px 16px 40px; }
    .hero h1 { font-size: 34px; }
    .hero p.bajada { font-size: 15px; }
    .encabezado-seccion { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
    .encabezado-seccion .nota { text-align: left; max-width: 100%; }
    .contenedor { padding: 0 16px; }
    .seccion { padding: 44px 0; }
    .rejilla-cortes { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .item-corte.destacado, .item-corte.normal { grid-column: span 1; }
    .fila-item { flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .fila-item .precio-accion { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 6px; }
    .rejilla-postres { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .tarjeta-postre { flex-direction: column; }
    .tarjeta-postre .marco-imagen { width: 100%; }
    .pie .rejilla-pie { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 26px; }
    .chips-secciones { top: 57px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ============ BARRA SUPERIOR ============ -->
<header class="barra-superior">
  <div class="franja">
    <a class="marca" href="#top">
      <span class="llama">🔥</span>
      <span class="nombre">FUEGO &amp; BRASAS<small>Asador de cortes</small></span>
    </a>
    <nav class="nav-cortes">
      <a href="#entradas">Entradas</a>
      <a href="#cortes">Cortes</a>
      <a href="#bebidas">Bebidas</a>
      <a href="#postres">Postres</a>
      <a href="#reservaciones">Reservaciones</a>
    </nav>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-carrito rounded-pill" id="btnCarrito">
      Carrito (<span id="contadorCarrito">0</span>)
    </button>
  </div>
</header>

<div id="top"></div>

<!-- ============ HERO ============ -->
<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-imagen" style="background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');"></div>
  <div class="hero-degradado"></div>

<!-- ============ TOAST DE CONFIRMACIÓN ============ -->
<div class="toast-container position-fixed bottom-0 end-0 p-3">
  <div id="toastCarrito" class="toast align-items-center text-white bg-success border-0" role="alert" aria-live="assertive" aria-atomic="true">
    <div class="d-flex">
      <div class="toast-body" id="toastMensaje">
        Agregado al carrito.
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast" aria-label="Cerrar"></button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/bootstrap/5.3.3/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
  let totalCarrito = 0;

  function agregarAlCarrito(nombrePlatillo, cantidad) {
    const cant = parseInt(cantidad, 10) || 1;
    totalCarrito += cant;
    document.getElementById('contadorCarrito').textContent = totalCarrito;

    const mensaje = cant === 1
      ? `${nombrePlatillo} se agregó al carrito.`
      : `${cant} x ${nombrePlatillo} se agregaron al carrito.`;
    document.getElementById('toastMensaje').textContent = mensaje;

    const toastEl = document.getElementById('toastCarrito');
    const toast = new bootstrap.Toast(toastEl, { delay: 2500 });
    toast.show();
  }

  document.getElementById('btnCarrito').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (totalCarrito === 0) {
      document.getElementById('toastMensaje').textContent = 'Tu carrito está vacío. ¡Agrega algo delicioso!';
    } else {
      document.getElementById('toastMensaje').textContent = `Tienes ${totalCarrito} producto(s) en tu carrito.`;
    }
    const toastEl = document.getElementById('toastCarrito');
    const toast = new bootstrap.Toast(toastEl, { delay: 2500 });
    toast.show();
  });
</script>

</body>
</html>
